description: goboxd challenges you to build a sandbox that runs untrusted code in Go on Linux. Solo or pairs; open registration for Stage 1, with IITM BS students eligible for placing. Top teams are also offered internship slots at SEEK.

registration.faqs: [{"q":"Where do I register officially?","a":"At the official spec page (intern-iitm.github.io/goboxd-hackathon); the central form confirms it."}]

schedule.name: Stage 01 — Build a prototype
schedule.description: Build a working sandbox that talks to the API; 10 teams advance.

schedule.name: Stage 02 — Extend to multiple languages
schedule.description: Extend the sandbox to multiple language toolchains; the same 10 teams continue.

schedule.name: Stage 03 — Harden it under pressure
schedule.description: An in-person 24-hour final stage to harden the sandbox; winners announced on site.

name: Logi Innoverse 2026
description: Logi InnoVerse 2026 challenges interdisciplinary student teams to solve real-world problems and build next-generation product ecosystems, exploring the future of tech, AI, and UX with Logitech. A pre-event journey (themes, an Innovation Preparation Kit, and a concept sprint) leads into a two-day main event.

schedule.name: Day 1 — Innovation Connect
schedule.description: Event introduction, a “Future of Innovation” tech talk by Logitech experts, and a mentorship sprint.

schedule.name: Day 2 — Innovation Expo
schedule.description: Mentor review checkpoint, an innovation showcase walkthrough, and final jury evaluation.

name: Hustlepreneurs By Escape Room
description: Hustlepreneurs is an entrepreneurial challenge extending Escape Room — combine problem-solving with startup thinking. Pitch a startup idea, navigate a high-pressure business-crisis case study, and present your venture to the judging panel.

registration.faqs: [{"q":"Is the event team-based?","a":"Yes — teams of 2 to 4 participants."},{"q":"Is a prototype required?","a":"No — you can present a startup idea through a pitch deck."}]

schedule.name: Online Submission
schedule.description: Submit a pitch deck covering vision, problem, solution, innovation, scalability, and business potential.

schedule.name: The Escape (Case Study)
schedule.description: Teams tackle a high-pressure startup crisis and pitch the most practical escape strategy.

schedule.name: The Pitch
schedule.description: Shortlisted teams present their startup ideas and field strategic questions from the panel.
